description_excerpt: Job Description • Receive specification documents from customer. • Import the content of specification in various formats (word, excel, pdf, matrix...) into Doors system, manage version, set attribute and layout as per customer requirement. • Ensure consistency of attribute, layouts for all modules. • Reflect changes of specification into system when having updates. • Develop and manage project metrics. • Be in charge of other activities such as system configuration management, baseline copy, tracking report... • Translate technical documents from Japanese to English and vice versa…
